title: Ant Group leads $100 million round in Chinese embodied-AI startup Simplexity at $1.6 billion valuation
summary: Ant Group led a $100 million pre-A funding round in Chinese embodied-AI company Simplexity Robotics at a $1.6 billion post-money valuation, co-founder and chairman Wang Kai confirmed to Bloomberg. Existing backers Alibaba, Tencent, HongShan and BlueRun also invested, according to the report.
